units.rawText: Well, since victory has been decided, we don't need to carry on with this ridiculous farce.
units.displayText: Well, since victory has been decided, we don't need to carry on with this ridiculous farce.

spans.text: Well, since victory has been decided, we don't need to carry on with this ridiculous farce.

units.rawText: Pardon the mess, ladies and gents. We'll be returning to the desk to continue the press conference.
units.displayText: Pardon the mess, ladies and gents. We'll be returning to the desk to continue the press conference.

spans.text: Pardon the mess, ladies and gents. We'll be returning to the desk to continue the press conference.

units.rawText: Kukurotte waves her hand to indicate to the thronging reporters that they shouldn't worry and turns to leave. Right now, nobody is paying attention to Jiangyu, who's lying on the ground.
units.displayText: Kukurotte waves her hand to indicate to the thronging reporters that they shouldn't worry and turns to leave. Right now, nobody is paying attention to Jiangyu, who's lying on the ground.

spans.text: Kukurotte waves her hand to indicate to the thronging reporters that they shouldn't worry and turns to leave. Right now, nobody is paying attention to Jiangyu, who's lying on the ground.

units.rawText: ...It's not... over yet...
units.displayText: ...It's not... over yet...

spans.text: ...It's not... over yet...

units.rawText: Big Sis is still... watching me...
units.displayText: Big Sis is still... watching me...

spans.text: Big Sis is still... watching me...

units.rawText: In her blurry vision, Jiangyu looks past the crowd at that pair of carefully sewn dolls. One of them just so happens to have the same look on their face as Daiyan herself.
units.displayText: In her blurry vision, Jiangyu looks past the crowd at that pair of carefully sewn dolls. One of them just so happens to have the same look on their face as Daiyan herself.

spans.text: In her blurry vision, Jiangyu looks past the crowd at that pair of carefully sewn dolls. One of them just so happens to have the same look on their face as Daiyan herself.

units.rawText: Come, Jiangyu. We can always practice the guzheng later.
units.displayText: Come, Jiangyu. We can always practice the guzheng later.

spans.text: Come, Jiangyu. We can always practice the guzheng later.

units.rawText: Big Sis... You don't have to bluff me. My personality is at odds with my job.
units.displayText: Big Sis... You don't have to bluff me. My personality is at odds with my job.

spans.text: Big Sis... You don't have to bluff me. My personality is at odds with my job.

units.rawText: Nobody's perfect, neither humans nor Dolls. Do what you're good at. The rest can be done by people who are better at it.
units.displayText: Nobody's perfect, neither humans nor Dolls. Do what you're good at. The rest can be done by people who are better at it.

spans.text: Nobody's perfect, neither humans nor Dolls. Do what you're good at. The rest can be done by people who are better at it.

units.rawText: But according to my design specifications, I'm supposed to be as good a guzheng-playing Doll as you.
units.displayText: But according to my design specifications, I'm supposed to be as good a guzheng-playing Doll as you.

spans.text: But according to my design specifications, I'm supposed to be as good a guzheng-playing Doll as you.

units.rawText: I know the scores and I can play them, but for some reason, I keep focusing on other things. I can't concentrate like you do.
units.displayText: I know the scores and I can play them, but for some reason, I keep focusing on other things. I can't concentrate like you do.

spans.text: I know the scores and I can play them, but for some reason, I keep focusing on other things. I can't concentrate like you do.

units.rawText: It's alright, Jiangyu.
units.displayText: It's alright, Jiangyu.

spans.text: It's alright, Jiangyu.

units.rawText: We might not be all that similar, but I'm sure that you'll find a path of your own someday.
units.displayText: We might not be all that similar, but I'm sure that you'll find a path of your own someday.

spans.text: We might not be all that similar, but I'm sure that you'll find a path of your own someday.

units.rawText: Do you have those two little dolls I made for you?
units.displayText: Do you have those two little dolls I made for you?

spans.text: Do you have those two little dolls I made for you?

units.rawText: Jiangyu nods wordlessly and takes out the dolls.
units.displayText: Jiangyu nods wordlessly and takes out the dolls.

spans.text: Jiangyu nods wordlessly and takes out the dolls.

units.rawText: Daiyan takes the blue one and lightly taps it against the red one.
units.displayText: Daiyan takes the blue one and lightly taps it against the red one.

spans.text: Daiyan takes the blue one and lightly taps it against the red one.

units.rawText: You see? They're not the same, and sometimes you leave one outside and put the other in your bag... But no matter where they wander, they always end up bumping into each other again.
units.displayText: You see? They're not the same, and sometimes you leave one outside and put the other in your bag... But no matter where they wander, they always end up bumping into each other again.

spans.text: You see? They're not the same, and sometimes you leave one outside and put the other in your bag... But no matter where they wander, they always end up bumping into each other again.

units.rawText: I'm looking forward to the day when we'll both be performing on stage together. How about that?
units.displayText: I'm looking forward to the day when we'll both be performing on stage together. How about that?

spans.text: I'm looking forward to the day when we'll both be performing on stage together. How about that?

units.rawText: ...Yup!
units.displayText: ...Yup!

spans.text: ...Yup!

units.rawText: ...I promised Big Sis I'd stand on stage with her.
units.displayText: ...I promised Big Sis I'd stand on stage with her.

spans.text: ...I promised Big Sis I'd stand on stage with her.

units.rawText: So there's no way I'm going down here...!
units.displayText: So there's no way I'm going down here...!

spans.text: So there's no way I'm going down here...!

units.rawText: ...She's gotten up!
units.displayText: ...She's gotten up!

spans.text: ...She's gotten up!

units.rawText: Following an exclamation by one of the reporters, the attention and camera lenses of the crowd turn to Jiangyu again.
units.displayText: Following an exclamation by one of the reporters, the attention and camera lenses of the crowd turn to Jiangyu again.

spans.text: Following an exclamation by one of the reporters, the attention and camera lenses of the crowd turn to Jiangyu again.

units.rawText: Why cause yourself so much pain? You should know that there's definitely no way you can beat me.
units.displayText: Why cause yourself so much pain? You should know that there's definitely no way you can beat me.

spans.text: Why cause yourself so much pain? You should know that there's definitely no way you can beat me.

units.rawText: Look at how pathetic you are. You can struggle as much as you like, but the only way this ends is with your defeat!
units.displayText: Look at how pathetic you are. You can struggle as much as you like, but the only way this ends is with your defeat!

spans.text: Look at how pathetic you are. You can struggle as much as you like, but the only way this ends is with your defeat!

units.rawText: You're right... But anyone who wants to play a righteous warrior can't back away, even outside of a movie!
units.displayText: You're right... But anyone who wants to play a righteous warrior can't back away, even outside of a movie!

spans.text: You're right... But anyone who wants to play a righteous warrior can't back away, even outside of a movie!

units.rawText: Since I've made up my mind to protect the people who are important to me, I'll fight to the very end!
units.displayText: Since I've made up my mind to protect the people who are important to me, I'll fight to the very end!

spans.text: Since I've made up my mind to protect the people who are important to me, I'll fight to the very end!

units.rawText: Jiangyu props herself up, her fighting spirit blazing in her eyes.
units.displayText: Jiangyu props herself up, her fighting spirit blazing in her eyes.

spans.text: Jiangyu props herself up, her fighting spirit blazing in her eyes.

units.rawText: You...
units.displayText: You...

spans.text: You...

units.rawText: <size=28>I'm really... starting to envy you.</size>
units.displayText: I'm really... starting to envy you.

spans.text: I'm really... starting to envy you.

units.rawText: Darkness flashes across Kukurotte's eyes, and then she clenches her fists again.
units.displayText: Darkness flashes across Kukurotte's eyes, and then she clenches her fists again.

spans.text: Darkness flashes across Kukurotte's eyes, and then she clenches her fists again.

units.rawText: Since you haven't admitted defeat yet, I'll play your little game.
units.displayText: Since you haven't admitted defeat yet, I'll play your little game.

spans.text: Since you haven't admitted defeat yet, I'll play your little game.

units.rawText: Allow me, as your senior, to teach you how to survive in this world.
units.displayText: Allow me, as your senior, to teach you how to survive in this world.

spans.text: Allow me, as your senior, to teach you how to survive in this world.

units.rawText: Kukurotte slowly approaches Jiangyu. The aura surrounding her hints at how much she wants to crush her opponent.
units.displayText: Kukurotte slowly approaches Jiangyu. The aura surrounding her hints at how much she wants to crush her opponent.

spans.text: Kukurotte slowly approaches Jiangyu. The aura surrounding her hints at how much she wants to crush her opponent.

units.rawText: System damage detected. Recommending immediate return to repair...
units.displayText: System damage detected. Recommending immediate return to repair...

spans.text: System damage detected. Recommending immediate return to repair...

units.rawText: (Oh, shut up. Disable system alerts.)
units.displayText: Oh, shut up. Disable system alerts.

spans.text: Oh, shut up. Disable system alerts.

units.rawText: Jiangyu carefully adjusts her systems' operating efficiency and puts all her attention on Kukurotte's movements.
units.displayText: Jiangyu carefully adjusts her systems' operating efficiency and puts all her attention on Kukurotte's movements.

spans.text: Jiangyu carefully adjusts her systems' operating efficiency and puts all her attention on Kukurotte's movements.

units.rawText: (She's stronger than me... Although her skills are roughly on the same level as mine, her strength alone might be greater than even Magnhilda's when she was sparring with me!)
units.displayText: She's stronger than me... Although her skills are roughly on the same level as mine, her strength alone might be greater than even Magnhilda's when she was sparring with me!

spans.text: She's stronger than me... Although her skills are roughly on the same level as mine, her strength alone might be greater than even Magnhilda's when she was sparring with me!

units.rawText: (When faced with a stronger opponent, offense isn't the best defense. I need to bob and weave the way Nascita does!)
units.displayText: When faced with a stronger opponent, offense isn't the best defense. I need to bob and weave the way Nascita does!

spans.text: When faced with a stronger opponent, offense isn't the best defense. I need to bob and weave the way Nascita does!

units.rawText: As the distance between the two of them shrinks, a vicious glint shines in Kukurotte's eyes, and she fires off a devastating punch, which Jiangyu evades.
units.displayText: As the distance between the two of them shrinks, a vicious glint shines in Kukurotte's eyes, and she fires off a devastating punch, which Jiangyu evades.

spans.text: As the distance between the two of them shrinks, a vicious glint shines in Kukurotte's eyes, and she fires off a devastating punch, which Jiangyu evades.

units.rawText: Trying to dodge?
units.displayText: Trying to dodge?

spans.text: Trying to dodge?

units.rawText: Kukurotte turns and punches again. Jiangyu manages to anticipate her opponent's moves, but it's slowly eating away at her.
units.displayText: Kukurotte turns and punches again. Jiangyu manages to anticipate her opponent's moves, but it's slowly eating away at her.

spans.text: Kukurotte turns and punches again. Jiangyu manages to anticipate her opponent's moves, but it's slowly eating away at her.

units.rawText: Heh... You claim to be a hero, but in the end, all you're going to do is run?
units.displayText: Heh... You claim to be a hero, but in the end, all you're going to do is run?

spans.text: Heh... You claim to be a hero, but in the end, all you're going to do is run?

units.rawText: You can't win if all you do is run away.
units.displayText: You can't win if all you do is run away.

spans.text: You can't win if all you do is run away.

units.rawText: Magnhilda's voice echoes in her mind. Jiangyu gathers her resolve.
units.displayText: Magnhilda's voice echoes in her mind. Jiangyu gathers her resolve.

spans.text: Magnhilda's voice echoes in her mind. Jiangyu gathers her resolve.

units.rawText: Alright, then... Since you like dodging so much, I'll let you dodge all you want!
units.displayText: Alright, then... Since you like dodging so much, I'll let you dodge all you want!

spans.text: Alright, then... Since you like dodging so much, I'll let you dodge all you want!

units.rawText: The pace of Kukurotte's attacks grows more and more oppressive, not giving Jiangyu any time to breathe.
units.displayText: The pace of Kukurotte's attacks grows more and more oppressive, not giving Jiangyu any time to breathe.

spans.text: The pace of Kukurotte's attacks grows more and more oppressive, not giving Jiangyu any time to breathe.

units.rawText: Hng...!
units.displayText: Hng...!

spans.text: Hng...!

units.rawText: In the face of Kukurotte's offensive, a crack finally appears in Jiangyu's defense, and a heavy punch lands on her upper arm!
units.displayText: In the face of Kukurotte's offensive, a crack finally appears in Jiangyu's defense, and a heavy punch lands on her upper arm!

spans.text: In the face of Kukurotte's offensive, a crack finally appears in Jiangyu's defense, and a heavy punch lands on her upper arm!

units.rawText: There's nowhere for you to run. Time to finish you off.
units.displayText: There's nowhere for you to run. Time to finish you off.

spans.text: There's nowhere for you to run. Time to finish you off.

units.displayText: Now...!

spans.text: Now...!

units.rawText: But Jiangyu doesn't dodge. Instead, she rushes into Kukurotte's fist.
units.displayText: But Jiangyu doesn't dodge. Instead, she rushes into Kukurotte's fist.

spans.text: But Jiangyu doesn't dodge. Instead, she rushes into Kukurotte's fist.

units.rawText: Just as she's about to get hit, Jiangyu tilts her head to the side and lands a hook on Kukurotte's jaw!
units.displayText: Just as she's about to get hit, Jiangyu tilts her head to the side and lands a hook on Kukurotte's jaw!

spans.text: Just as she's about to get hit, Jiangyu tilts her head to the side and lands a hook on Kukurotte's jaw!

units.rawText: The hit is clean and audible.
units.displayText: The hit is clean and audible.

spans.text: The hit is clean and audible.

units.rawText: ...Got you!
units.displayText: ...Got you!

spans.text: ...Got you!

units.rawText: Kukurotte works her jaw, which creaks audibly.
units.displayText: Kukurotte works her jaw, which creaks audibly.

spans.text: Kukurotte works her jaw, which creaks audibly.

units.rawText: She hasn't taken a real hit like this in a long time. The pain is alien yet familiar at the same time, and it brings with it a storm of emotions.
units.displayText: She hasn't taken a real hit like this in a long time. The pain is alien yet familiar at the same time, and it brings with it a storm of emotions.

spans.text: She hasn't taken a real hit like this in a long time. The pain is alien yet familiar at the same time, and it brings with it a storm of emotions.

units.rawText: You think you've won?!
units.displayText: You think you've won?!

spans.text: You think you've won?!

units.rawText: Kukurotte grabs the fist that Jiangyu hit her with in one hand and seizes her shoulder with the other.
units.displayText: Kukurotte grabs the fist that Jiangyu hit her with in one hand and seizes her shoulder with the other.

spans.text: Kukurotte grabs the fist that Jiangyu hit her with in one hand and seizes her shoulder with the other.

units.rawText: Bam! She slams Jiangyu to the ground with a mighty crash.
units.displayText: Bam! She slams Jiangyu to the ground with a mighty crash.

spans.text: Bam! She slams Jiangyu to the ground with a mighty crash.

units.rawText: It's useless.
units.displayText: It's useless.

spans.text: It's useless.

units.rawText: Kukurotte plants one foot on Jiangyu's face and slowly exerts her strength. Jiangyu can hear the sounds of her cranial frame deforming.
units.displayText: Kukurotte plants one foot on Jiangyu's face and slowly exerts her strength. Jiangyu can hear the sounds of her cranial frame deforming.

spans.text: Kukurotte plants one foot on Jiangyu's face and slowly exerts her strength. Jiangyu can hear the sounds of her cranial frame deforming.

units.rawText: She tries to struggle, but Kukurotte leans in, speaking in a voice that only the two of them can hear.
units.displayText: She tries to struggle, but Kukurotte leans in, speaking in a voice that only the two of them can hear.

spans.text: She tries to struggle, but Kukurotte leans in, speaking in a voice that only the two of them can hear.

units.rawText: You're walking down the same path I did.
units.displayText: You're walking down the same path I did.

spans.text: You're walking down the same path I did.

units.rawText: It doesn't matter how hard you train. Martial arts is dead. Nobody wants to see REAL kung fu. There IS no path of chivalry or righteousness.
units.displayText: It doesn't matter how hard you train. Martial arts is dead. Nobody wants to see REAL kung fu. There IS no path of chivalry or righteousness.

spans.text: It doesn't matter how hard you train. Martial arts is dead. Nobody wants to see REAL kung fu. There IS no path of chivalry or righteousness.

units.rawText: If you want to be seen, then you need a spectacle.
units.displayText: If you want to be seen, then you need a spectacle.

spans.text: If you want to be seen, then you need a spectacle.

units.rawText: People will always love kung fu... Just like the kind Old Man Su...
units.displayText: People will always love kung fu... Just like the kind Old Man Su...

spans.text: People will always love kung fu... Just like the kind Old Man Su...

units.rawText: <size=40>DON'T YOU DARE MENTION HIM!</size>
units.displayText: DON'T YOU DARE MENTION HIM!

spans.text: DON'T YOU DARE MENTION HIM!

units.rawText: The foot crushing Jiangyu's face grows more forceful, and intense pain signals flood her mind.
units.displayText: The foot crushing Jiangyu's face grows more forceful, and intense pain signals flood her mind.

spans.text: The foot crushing Jiangyu's face grows more forceful, and intense pain signals flood her mind.

units.rawText: <size=40><color=red>NGHHAHHHHH!!!!</color></size>
units.displayText: NGHHAHHHHH!!!!

spans.text: NGHHAHHHHH!!!!

units.rawText: Jiangyu thrashes, but she can't shake off Kukurotte's overpowering strength.
units.displayText: Jiangyu thrashes, but she can't shake off Kukurotte's overpowering strength.

spans.text: Jiangyu thrashes, but she can't shake off Kukurotte's overpowering strength.

units.rawText: <size=40>That's enough!</size>
units.displayText: That's enough!

spans.text: That's enough!

units.rawText: Nascita's shout interrupts this one-sided beatdown.
units.displayText: Nascita's shout interrupts this one-sided beatdown.

spans.text: Nascita's shout interrupts this one-sided beatdown.

units.rawText: I'm throwing in the towel on Jiangyu's behalf. Let her go.
units.displayText: I'm throwing in the towel on Jiangyu's behalf. Let her go.
